text:
nina: FYI I opened a PR to stitch the small troubleshooting pages (429s, timeouts, context limits) into one canonical error-ref: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4519

owen: Nice. Can we include a tiny 'first steps' checklist at the top: 1) confirm 429 vs timeout, 2) attempt graceful fallback, 3) capture trace + route headers. Keep it 3 bullets.

min: I can add compact SDK snippets (Node + Python) showing graceful fallback and the recommended header to avoid duplicate retries. Will keep them single-call examples.

min: Node snippet (compact):
```js
// fallback to cheaper model on 429
const r = await client.generate({ prompt });
if (r.status === 429) {
  await client.generate({ prompt, model: 'gpt-lite', headers: { 'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful' } });
}
```

min: Python snippet (compact):
```py
# fallback to cheaper model on 429
r = client.generate(prompt)
if r.status_code == 429:
    client.generate(prompt, model='gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode':'graceful'})
```

riley: Please add a one-line migration note for teams using the old client-side retry wrapper: they should disable the wrapper or set `X-RI-Retry-Mode=disabled` to avoid double retries when switching to the unified handler.

nina: Good call. Also add a tiny observability example recommending `X-RI-Route`, `X-RI-Trace`, and `X-RI-Retry-Mode` headers so support/ops can correlate fallback events. One short paragraph.

owen: For context-limit guidance: show a before/after prompt-trim example and recommend trimming long conversational user turns first, then non-critical system messages. Quick tip: use the console helper `context-trim --preserve=system --max-tokens=2048` in the example.

min: Edge-case to call out: streaming + 429 mid-stream. Advice: abort and mark partial as incomplete; if you support resumable streams, include last-token offset in `X-RI-Resume-Offset` so clients can resume cleanly.

doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md has 2 broken links and 1 style warning. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4991/checks

nina: I'll run the link-sweep post-merge (scan SDK pages + devex crosslinks). Targeting merge next Tue after CI fixes. Please leave any odd edge-cases here; we'll add short troubleshooting bullets.

min: I'll push Node/Python snippets + observability paragraph later today.

riley: I'll draft the migration sentence + the context-trim before/after and drop it as a small commit.

owen: I'll review wording and the top checklist. If CI still flags anchors, we'll iterate. Thanks all :thumbsup:
